أَرْضٌ جَرِذَةٌ Land containing, (S, L,) or abounding with, (K,) [the large field-rats called] جِرْذَان; (S, L, K;) like ارض فَئِرَةٌ. (A.) ―
-b2- دَابَّةٌ جَرِذٌ, (M, L,) or فَرَسٌ جَرِذٌ, (Mgh,) (tropical:) A beast, or horse, affected with the kind of swelling termed جَرَذٌ. (M, Mgh, L.) And رَجُلٌ جَرِذُ الرِّجْلَيْنِ (tropical:) [A man whose legs are affected with similar swellings]. (M, L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
